english: ...Kufufu.\nTwin Angel, huh.
Still just little kids\nplaying heroine, I'd say?
Riko'll show you what a real phantom thief is.
The St. Cherinu Academy's secret treasure,\nthe 'Tears of the Angel'—I'll be taking it.
While they're busy falling for the diversion!
//Event art off.
//Screen shake, etc.
Aaah! Those robots are rampaging again!
Thanks to the quick report,\nthe damage still isn't too bad!
But they're not attacking people—\nthey're targeting buildings?
Mr. Robot!\nYou mustn't do that~!
...Haruka-san!
Yeah!
Everyone, we'll go\nfetch Twin Angel!
Roger. Leave it to us till then!
All right, you're dealing with ME!\nMy teacher said doing bad things\nis a no-no!
I-I may not be much help, but\nI'll do my best!
Um, Sonico-san,\nmaybe you should run instead of pushing yourself...
//To the battle map.
//Twin Angel arrive where Tsubasa and the others are.
Sorry to keep you waiting~!\nTwin Angel, here!
Let's do our best, everyone!
Yes!
Wow! Powerful backup arrives!\nHmm, at this rate my role\nmight get overshadowed...?
We'll beat every last one of those\ntown-wrecking robots!
(Phantom Thief Twintail-san isn't here...?\nShe should be the one\ncommanding these robots...?)
What's wrong?
Ah, no, I was just wondering\nwhat the point of this attack is...
The point? Hmm... but either way,\nwe can't let them wreck the town!
Right!
//Battle start.
//After the condition is met (defeat a set number of enemies).
Phew, we've cleaned up quite a bit!
Keep it up! Keep it up!
(Phantom Thief Twintail still hasn't shown up?\nWhich means...?)
What's wrong?\n...Ah, there's someone over there!
//Black Aria appears.
I'll ventilate... you.
That black figure again...!
Different from the Black Fund's\nmen in black, maybe?
But she's so small and cute...
Who said what's tiny!? I'll freakin' kill you!
Awawa!? I-I'm sorry!\nThat's not what I meant!
Watch out! She's targeting Niko-chan!!
To bare her hostility this openly...!
//Battle resumes.
Ngh...!
//Retreat.
Ah, she got away!?\nAt least stop these robots first~!
From watching her movements,\nshe seems unrelated to the robots.
//Battle resumes.
//Battle end (all enemies wiped out).
All done!
So it was just unmanned weapons running wild...\nHey, do incidents like this\nhappen often in this world?
No—usual incidents are art theft\nor smuggling; destructive rampages in broad daylight\nare almost unheard of.
...Which means—ah!!
This is a diversion...!!
//Battle end.
//Background: Cherinu Academy.
As I suspected... it was stolen.
N-no... the 'Tears of the Angel'...
What exactly is the 'Tears of the Angel'?
...Understood.\nI'll tell you all.
In this world there are treasures\ncalled 'Holy Grail fragments'\nthat hold great power.
The most powerful of them\nis the necklace called the 'Tears of the Angel',\nkept here at this academy.
That treasure got stolen!?\nThe one who makes impossible missions possible is\nEtha... no, that can't be...
Twin Angel and I are\nAmanotsukai—guardians of\nthe 'Holy Grail fragments'...
And yet\nwe couldn't protect the 'Tears of the Angel'.\nUgh, what a huge failure...
But few people know\nthe 'Tears of the Angel' is here.
The academy's security is solid.\nIt shouldn't be easy to break through...
Could it be that Phantom Thief Twintail, I wonder?
But wasn't there any clue at the scene?
Unfortunately, no...
I thought this was an action shoot,\nbut there's a mystery element too...!
What do we do, Aoi-chan, what do we do?
It's all right, Haruka-san.\nHalf of the 'Tears of the Angel' is still safe.
Hm? Half is safe? What do you mean?
Because the 'Tears of the Angel' was stored\nsplit in two.
Ehhh!? Really!?
Actually, after meeting Phantom Thief Twintail-san the other day\nI had a bad feeling, so\nI asked my grandmother to arrange it.
So because it was changed so recently,\nthe thief didn't notice.
Amazing!!\nSpecial crisis-management skills activated!!
So Aoi-chan plays the great detective!\nAoi-chan, how did you know\nthe 'Tears of the Angel' was being targeted...?
Because those robots were\nattacking town buildings indiscriminately.
Destruction with no discernible motive\nsuggested some kind of diversion.
That thief popped up briefly in the last fight\nand vanished right away—what was that about?
That was likely to make us aware\nof Phantom Thief Twintail's existence.
Ugh... I don't get it~.
In other words, it was to make us believe\nthat if those robots showed up again,\nPhantom Thief Twintail would be with them.
So we were lured out, hook, line, and sinker.
But why did Phantom Thief Twintail-san\nintroduce herself in a way that\nimmediately gives away she's a thief...?
Because she's a phantom thief?\nStealing in silence, no one'd notice.\nMaybe she was confident in her skills?
Thanks to that, the worst was avoided.\nThe 'Tears of the Angel' only shows its power\nwhen both halves are together.
What if both halves of the 'Tears of the Angel' had been stolen?
They'd gain power\nbeyond human handling.
And Twin Angel protects it.
Yes.
This remaining half of the 'Tears of the Angel'\nwill be in my keeping.\n...I'll just tuck it away here.
Awawa!
(Wah, she's gonna put it THERE?\nEek~)
But this makes you a target.
The Kannazuki family too\nis fated to guard the Holy Grail fragments.\n...Don't worry.
B-but... it's dangerous.
I'm prepared.\nBesides, we must take back\nthe stolen half of the Tears of the Angel.
Phantom Thief Twintail will likely\ncome after the 'Tears of the Angel' again.
Lure her out and reel her in instead—nice plan!
Yes. Though it won't be easy.
You've got me and Twin Angel on your side—\nit'll be fine!
All right!\nWe're already in your debt,\nso we'll help with everything we've got!!
Thank you, everyone.
//Background: town at night.\n//Riko talking on the phone with Nine, the client's agent.
A fake!? No way!\nWhat I sent was the 'Tears of the Angel'!
Unfortunately, this 'Tears of the Angel'\ndoesn't show any power.
That's ridiculous...!!
The client is displeased.
Fine! Then Riko'll just go again...!
That won't be necessary.\nYou will receive\nfurther instructions from the client.
Why!? You're not even giving me a chance to make up for it!?
I'm merely relaying the decision.\nMine Riko Lupin IV.
I'm Riko! Drop the 'IV'!
That is all.\nDisconnecting.
Don't screw with me! Twin Angel, I'll pay you back for this, I swear...!
//END
